question: What comprehensive division does the seeker wish to know fully?
premises: There is a division into eight octads
The seeker desires full knowledge of it
This knowledge is sought without limit
inference: The seeker asks to know fully and endlessly the division of the eight octads.
uncertainties: anantathā may qualify extent or manner; taken as endlessly/completely
plain_english: I wish to know fully and completely the division of the eight octads.
